Replace.Text: 游戏初期便解锁“占星术”。所有城市在建立时免费获得一个市中心建筑（若标准远古时代开局，免费送一个纪念碑）。每有1座圣城皈依拜占庭的宗教（也包括拜占庭的圣城），单位便获得+8 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力或 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。击杀敌方文明或城邦的单位时，拜占庭的宗教将传播到附近的城市。如城市拥有圣地区域，其提供的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数+1。

Unlock Astrology early in the game. All cities start with an additional City Center building. If starting in the Ancient Era, this is a Monument. Units receive +8 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength or [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength for each Holy City converted to Byzantium's Religion (including Byzantium's Holy City). Byzantium's Religion is spread to nearby cities when defeating a unit belonging to an enemy civilization or city-state. +1 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet point from cities with a Holy Site district
法家治国
Chinese Legalism

军队可以捕获非蛮族单位成为工人或杀死单位传播宗教。近战和抗骑兵单位可以归顺蛮族，初始次数为1，获得圣索菲亚大教堂后变为2次，次数耗尽则单位消失。解锁货币后解锁并免费获得1名间谍（并增加1个间谍容量），间谍可以自由选择升级。[NEWLINE]城市减少50% [ICON_Production] 生产力、 [ICON_Science] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，[ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞不再提供科技与市政。游戏初期便解锁“占星术”和“造船术”，解锁“砌砖”科技的同时也解锁“运河”。创建或攻占的城市自动拥有贸易站且自动创建一条通向首都的路（如果位于首都贸易路线范围内）。宫殿拥有6个巨作槽位，[ICON_GreatWork_Sculpture] 雕塑、[ICON_GreatWork_Portrait] 肖像、[ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 风景、[ICON_GreatWork_Religious] 宗教巨作、[ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物、[ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作、[ICON_GreatWork_Music] 音乐、[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、[ICON_GreatWork_HeroRelic] 英雄遗物（限英雄模式）+2 [ICON_Food] 食物。建造奇观或区域时，可以使用建造者推进25%的进度。

Combat units can capture non-barbians as workers or kill them to spread the religion. Melee and anti-cavalry units can recruit barbarians. This starts with 1 charge but up to 2 with the Hagia Sophia. Upon unlocking Currency, unlock and gain 1 Spy for free (Spy capacity increased by 1).[NEWLINE]Cities yield 50% less [ICON_Production] Production, [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture, [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspirations no longer provide civics and technologies. Unlock Astrology and Shipbuilding early in the game. Unlocking Masonry also unlocks the Canal. Cities founded or captured automatically have a Trading Post and automatically create a road to the Capital (if within the Capital's Trade Route range). 为集体而战
Fight for all
近战和抗骑兵单位可以归顺蛮族，初始次数为1，获得圣索菲亚大教堂后变为2次，次数耗尽则单位消失。
Melee and anti-cavalry units can recruit barbarians. This starts with 1 charge but up to 2 with the Hagia Sophia. The unit disappears when charges exhausted.

游戏初级便解锁“马镫”。创建 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线后，目的地城市中将立即出现1座 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站。在一个文明的任意城市中拥有1座 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站后，[ICON_VisLimited] 外交能见度则上升1级。只要拥有比敌方更高的 [ICON_VisLimited] 外交能见度，所有蒙古单位情报 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力加成则翻1倍。

Stirrups is unlocked early in the game. After creating a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route, 1 [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post immediately appears in the destination city. After you have 1 [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post in any city of a civilization, [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility increases by 1 level. As long as you have higher [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility than the enemy, the intelligence [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength bonus of all Mongolian units is doubled.
游戏初期便解锁“占星术”。从城市中的每种宗教（至少有一个信徒）获得信徒信仰加成。
游戏初期便解锁“占星术”。从城市中的每个宗教（其须拥有至少1个信徒）获得信徒信仰加成。城市从每个宗教（须有至少1个信徒）获得1点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。传教士的传播次数+2。来自 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的宗教压力+100%。
Unlock Astrology early in the game. Receives Follower Belief bonuses in a city from each Religion that has at least 1 follower.

Unlock Astrology early in the game. Receives Follower Belief bonuses in a city from each Religion that has at least 1 Follower. Cities gain an [ICON_Amenities] Amenity for every Religion with at least 1 Follower. Missionaries have +2 spreads. +100% Religious pressure from your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
游戏初期便解锁“占星术”。当区域与区域相邻时，所有区域获得一个额外的标准相邻加成。
Unlock Astrology early in the game. All districts receive an additional standard adjacency bonus for being adjacent to another district.

游戏初期便解锁“占星术”。解锁“重商主义”后（而非“民族主义”和“动员”）即可组建舰队和无敌舰队。[ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+3 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。如 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线横跨多个大陆，则这些数值将乘以3倍。如城市处于非原始首都所在大陆，其建成时将获得1名建造者，建造区域时+25% [ICON_Production] 生产力。
